Handed to the team · RMA approval pending since Nov 6, re-flagged Nov 11, still no approval; customer

I checked your order. Your BS-2 return still hasn't been approved, and I've flagged it to the team again.

Chris, the order itself was delivered to (address hidden) on September 18, so I take it you mean the return. Hal confirmed the fault on November 6. We told you an email would come shortly, and 11 days later you still don't have one. I'm sorry about that.

Your diagnosis and your pick of the Thor P2 are on the order. Someone will get back to you with the approval and your return label. Is the Thor P2 still the one you want?
Not sure which one I want yet. Just checking on the RMA status

That's fine, Chris, you don't have to decide now.

The RMA is still waiting for approval. It hasn't been approved yet and no return label has been made. I've flagged it again with Hal's diagnosis and your test results, so nobody needs anything more from you.

Someone will get back to you by email with the approval and the label. You can choose the replacement then. Until then, keep the BS-2 unplugged.
I am worried that for some reason after too long of wait the RMA will not be approved.

I understand why you're worried, Chris, but the wait won't count against you.

You reported the fault on November 6. That date is on your order, along with Hal's diagnosis and your test results. Hal found a short on the AIO 12V input, and you confirmed the unit was never overclocked. The days since then are our delay, not yours.

I can't tell you the decision before the team makes it. Your case is fully documented and flagged, and someone will email you about it.
You're welcome, Chris. Your return is flagged and all your notes are on the order. Someone will email you with the approval and your label. Keep the BS-2 unplugged until then.
